interaction_notes: Vit D restoration is the single highest-leverage move — it sits upstream of 3 of your 4 sub-optimal findings (atopy, T, RDW).
Circadian shift + sleep architecture is the second-highest lever — directly drives T synthesis, modulates cortisol diurnal curve.
Atopic + parasitic dual-track keeps the eosinophilia interpretation honest. Don't assume; test.
The 4-grandparent longevity baseline + already-optimal metabolic profile means: marginal gains. You don't need a big intervention; you need precision.
